selectionRule: Static scoring nominated the shortlist; fixed-camera galaxy maps and home low-flight/surface/boarding captures decided the release seed.
reasons: The central bar, bulge, primary arms and secondary branches remain readable at full-galaxy zoom.
The home world has 0.825 plate coherence, 0.420 cloud coverage and the strongest mountain profile among the visually acceptable finalists.
Final high-quality orbit, low-flight and surface captures beat MILKY-234, MILKY-104 and MILKY-166 on the combined balance of coherent landmasses, relief and broken-cloud weather.
The 64-system sample retains all nine natural primary-world types while keeping the distant floating-city and central-black-hole routes.
